title: The real-world missile defense lessons from Ukraine and Iran — and how they matter for China - Breaking Defense
html:
Militaries around the globe have been studying the Ukraine and Iran conflicts to learn about the impacts of missile technologies, drones and air defense systems. But every conflict is different, and every region has different needs.

To understand what lessons are and are not applicable in different parts of the world, Becca Wasser of Bloomberg Economics and Mark Cancian of the Center for International and Strategic Studies joined Breaking Defense Editor-in-Chief Aaron Mehta for this new roundtable video.

Keep an eye on future episodes here, and catch part one here.
summary: What works in Ukraine may not be the same systems needed for a Pacific conflict, according to Breaking Defense’s video roundtable.
